hook: White to move. One of these mates; two do not.
text: White to move. One of these mates; two do not. Black's king is boxed in by its own rook and pawns. Pick the knight move and answer with a reaction: ❤ Nf7 🔥 Nxh7 👏 Ne6 The answer, and the idea behind it, lands in a reply to this post at 14:30 UTC.

creative.headline:
White to play.
*One knight move.*
creative.subhead: Boxed in by its own pieces.
creative.footer: Answer as a reply at 14:30 UTC.

reveal.text: Solved: Nf7#. The king on h8 has no flight square: g8 holds its own rook, g7 and h7 hold its own pawns. A knight check cannot be blocked, and nothing on the board can capture the knight on f7. Nxh7 fails to Kxh7, and Ne6 gives nothing at all. When the king is boxed in, look for the check that cannot be answered.

creative.headline:
Smothered.
*Nf7 is mate.*
creative.subhead: The king's own pieces closed the door.
